business_model.claim: The company is a distributor of specialty food and center-of-the-plate products in the United States, the Middle East and Canada.

quotes: Our product portfolio includes over 90,000 stock-keeping units (“SKUs”) from more than 4,000 different suppliers and is comprised primarily of imported and domestic specialty food products, such as artisan charcuterie, specialty cheeses, unique oils and vinegars, truffles, caviar, chocolate and pastry products.

business_model.claim: Besides specialty items, it sells center-of-the-plate proteins plus produce and broadline staples, so customers can use it as their primary distributor.
quotes: We also offer an extensive line of center-of-the-plate products, including custom cut beef, seafood and hormone-free poultry, as well as produce and broadline food products, such as cooking oils, butter, eggs, milk and flour.

business_model.claim: Customers are more than 55,000 core customer locations, and most of them are independent restaurants and fine dining establishments.
quotes: We serve more than 55,000 Core Customer locations, primarily located in our twenty-three geographic markets across the United States, the Middle East and Canada, and the majority of our customers are independent restaurants and fine dining establishments.

business_model.claim: A smaller direct-to-consumer channel, Allen Brothers, sells center-of-the-plate products by mail and e-commerce.
quotes: Additionally, we market certain of our center-of-the-plate products directly to consumers through our Allen Brothers, Inc. (“Allen Brothers”) mail and e-commerce platform.

business_model.claim: Customer concentration is low: the top ten customers made up about 6% of fiscal 2025 net sales.
quotes: We have no meaningful customer concentration as our top ten customers accounted for approximately 6% of total net sales for our 2025 fiscal year.

business_model.claim: Sales are made on individual purchase orders, not long-term contracts, so customers can switch.
quotes: Most of our customers buy from us pursuant to individual purchase orders, as we generally do not enter into long-term agreements with our customers for the purchase of our products.

business_model.claim: The company sells to customers on credit, with payment terms mostly of 14 to 60 days.
quotes: Most of our customers have payment terms from 14 to 60 days.

business_model.claim: Customers are reached through 44 distribution centers and the company's own delivery fleet.
quotes: We operate 44 distribution centers and provide service six days a week in many of our service areas, utilizing our fleet of delivery trucks to fill our customers’ orders.

business_model.claim: Selling relies on a sales force of about 1,100 sales and customer service professionals who also act as a route-to-market for suppliers.
quotes: We maintain collaborative relationships with thousands of chefs while also acting as a critical marketing arm and route-to-market for many of our suppliers by leveraging an experienced and sophisticated sales force of approximately 1,100 sales and customer service professionals.

Management says sales growth comes mainly from volume and, to a lesser degree, from price changes driven by commodity inflation and product mix.
quotes: Our net sales growth is driven principally by changes in volume and, to a lesser degree, changes in price related to the impact of inflation in commodity prices and product mix.

business_model.claim: Volume is measured in two product categories: case count for specialty and pounds sold for center-of-the-plate.
quotes: We use case count as the volume measurement in our specialty product category and pounds sold as the volume measurement in our center-of-the-plate category.

business_model.claim: Third-quarter 2026 net sales rose 11.2%: organic growth contributed $105.4 million (10.3%) and acquisitions, mainly Italco, contributed $8.7 million (0.9%).
quotes: Organic growth contributed $105.4 million, or 10.3%, to sales growth and the remaining growth of $8.7 million, or 0.9%, primarily resulted from our acquisition of Italco.

business_model.claim: In the third quarter of 2026, organic specialty case count rose about 6.1% and organic center-of-the-plate pounds rose 6.6%.
quotes: Organic case count increased approximately 6.1% in our specialty category, representing an increase in net sales of $38.3 million.

business_model.claim: Inflation also lifted third-quarter 2026 sales: by $16.2 million (2.6%) in specialty and by $26.0 million (6.6%) in center-of-the-plate.
quotes: Estimated inflation increased sales by $16.2 million, or 2.6% in our specialty category and by $26.0 million, or 6.6% in our center-of-the-plate category compared to the prior year quarter.

business_model.claim: Most prices are set at the time of order and cost changes are usually passed on to customers; some protein items are priced cost-plus.
quotes: The majority of our pricing is set at the time of order and we typically pass cost increases or decreases to our customers.

business_model.claim: Cost of sales is mainly the purchase price of products, plus inbound freight and food processing costs.
quotes: Cost of sales include the net purchase price paid for products sold, plus the cost of transportation necessary to bring the product to our distribution facilities and food processing costs.

business_model.claim: Gross margin was 25.0% in Q3 2026 versus 24.2% a year earlier, up about 84 basis points on pricing, cost management and a richer product mix.
quotes: Gross profit margin increased approximately 84 basis points due to effective pricing and product cost management in an inflationary “food away from home” environment, together with growth in certain higher-margin products within our aggregate product mix.

business_model.claim: SG&A, which covers facilities, shipping, warehouse and other selling costs, was 20.6% of Q3 2026 net sales versus 20.4%, with stock compensation and fuel adding to the ratio.
quotes: Our ratio of selling, general and administrative expenses to net sales increased 20 basis points due to higher stock-based compensation costs associated with certain performance-based awards and higher fuel costs.

business_model.claim: It is a low-margin model: operating income was 4.4% of Q3 2026 net sales versus 3.8% a year earlier.
quotes: As a percentage of net sales, operating income was 4.4% in the third quarter of 2026 as compared to 3.8% in the third quarter of 2025.
We operate within a segment of the foodservice distribution industry, which is an industry characterized by a high volume of sales with relatively low profit margins.

business_model.claim: Labor is a significant cost, particularly in center-of-the-plate; the company had 5,156 full-time employees at fiscal 2025 year-end.
quotes: Because our labor costs (particularly those in our center-of-the-plate category) are, as a percentage of revenues, higher than other industries, we may be significantly harmed by labor cost increases.

business_model.claim: The company does not hedge food price risk with financial instruments.
quotes: Moreover, we do not currently use financial instruments to hedge our risk exposure to market fluctuations in the price of food products.

business_model.claim: Demand depends on food-away-from-home spending, which moves with the economy and consumer discretionary spending.
quotes: When economic conditions deteriorate, our customers’ businesses are negatively impacted as fewer people eat away-from-home and those who do spend less money.
